news.title: Nubank Launches US Deposit Account Through Sponsor Bank Partnership
news.body: Nubank has introduced a US deposit account via a sponsor bank, marking its first deposit product directly available to American consumers. This expansion puts Nubank in direct competition with US neobanks and traditional banks, as it adapts its Latin American strategy for the US market. Nubank’s leadership is actively recruiting US customers and working with regulators to ensure compliance as it seeks to establish a foothold outside Brazil.

news.title: Mastercard Pursues Stablecoin Partnerships and Acquisitions for Payments Growth
news.body: Mastercard’s CFO outlined a strategy focused on building stablecoin infrastructure and acquiring complementary businesses to capture new payment flows. Mastercard is actively seeking partnerships with merchants and issuers and engaging with regulators to advance stablecoin settlement, aiming to strengthen its position against Visa and fintech competitors.

news.title: Revolut Data Breach Raises Security Concerns After Government Email Scam
news.body: Revolut reported a breach where fraudsters exploited a legitimate government email domain to access sensitive customer data. The incident exposes Revolut to increased regulatory scrutiny and could slow customer acquisition, as competitors highlight their own security measures to attract wary users.

news.title: Tabby Raises $233M, Reaches $6.5B Valuation to Accelerate Middle East BNPL Expansion
news.body: Saudi-based BNPL fintech Tabby secured $233 million in new funding, raising its valuation to $6.5 billion. The investment will support product development and regional expansion, intensifying competition with other BNPL providers as Gulf consumers increasingly adopt installment payment options.

news.title: Bank of Ireland Partners With Stripe to Modernize Digital Banking
news.body: Bank of Ireland announced a partnership with Stripe to upgrade its digital services, aiming to set a new benchmark for Irish banking. By integrating Stripe’s payments infrastructure and developer tools, Bank of Ireland seeks to enhance customer experiences and prompt rivals to accelerate their own digital transformations.

perspective: Nubank’s US entry and Mastercard’s stablecoin push highlight how global fintechs and incumbents are reshaping US banking and payments security.
